beats.text: One good demo proves very little.
beats.say: How do you know if your agent is any good? Its behavior varies, so one successful demo proves very little.
Start with a test set: realistic tasks, each with a clear definition of success.
Measure more than the final answer: success rate, number of steps, cost, and latency.

beats.text: Check the trajectory, not just the answer.
beats.say: Also check the trajectory: right tools, sensible order, correct arguments. A right answer reached the wrong way is fragile.

beats.text: LLM judges need a rubric and spot-checks.
beats.say: For fuzzy outputs, use an LLM as a judge with a clear rubric, and spot-check it against human ratings.

beats.text: Run on every change. Track the trend.
beats.say: Run the suite on every change, and run each task several times, since results vary. Track the trend, and add every real failure to the test set.

beats.text: That wraps up the agentic AI series!
beats.say: That wraps up the agentic AI series. Follow for more.
